contexts.text: Arcana never revealed heretofore.
The (Most Ancients) had Knowledges... by revelations; for they spoke with the Lord, and with Angels; and were also instructed by visions and dreams. AC 597.
The third posterity... began not to believe in things revealed, unless they saw and felt that they were so. AC 208.
The fruit of the tree of the garden = the good and truth revealed to them from the Most Ancient Church. AC 199.
Then, in place of the revelations of the Most Ancient Church, there succeeded doctrinal things which were first apprehended with the external senses...
Some of the revelations of the Most Ancient Church were preserved for (their) use.

(For the spiritual man) can know nothing of the truth of faith except from the things revealed in the Word... The particulars are never so revealed to man... It is quite different with the celestial man...
The man of the Most Ancient Church had revelations, by which he was initiated from infancy into the perception of goods and truths; and... he perceived innumerable things without new instruction...
Many are regenerated... in every dogma, and, when they have been regenerated, they do not receive any immediate revelation, but only the things insinuated through the Word...
(The arcana of the internal sense) are not revealed until the mind is removed from the sense of the letter.
As if one would learn nothing unless he had a revelation.

It has been necessary that some revelation... should come forth; for a revelation, or Word, is the common recipient vessel of spiritual and celestial things, thus conjoining Heaven and earth; without it, they would have been disjoined, and the human race would have perished...
That after the combats in (His) childhood there was a revelation. Signified.
That a vision = inmost revelation, which is that of perception. Explained.
The Lord's instruction in general... was by continual revelations, and thus by Divine perceptions and thoughts from Himself...
That it will thus be revealed. Signified, Explained.
There is then something like revelation in prayer... Hence, to pray = to be revealed... The prayer of the Lord was... at the same time revelation. Illustrated.
Revelation. Signified, Explained.
The Lord progressed... by continual revelations from His Divine.
That no one sees what the Word is in its internal sense... but he to whom He reveals it. Signified.
(This) appears too remote to be known without a revelation.
As truth is meant by the Word, all revelation is meant.
The Word in the Most Ancient Church was not written, but was revealed to everyone of that Church. Explained.
Who could know, except from an interior searching of the Word, and at the same time from revelation, that...
By continual revelations from Himself... He united the Divine essence to the human essence. Signified, Explained.
He revealed them to Himself, when He was in a state of the unition of the Human with the Divine. Signified.
He acquired to Himself all intelligence and wisdom by continual revelations from the Divine.
The arcana of the internal sense are now revealed, because (now) there is scarcely any faith... and, when this is the case, they can be revealed without danger of profanation... AC 6595:end.
They know indeed from revelation that...
The natural man... cannot know spiritual good and truth; for this must be from revelation, thus from the Word. Example(s).
The arcana of this heavenly marriage are here revealed...
He supposes that the Lord could save everyone... by immediate revelations.
(On this account) man is not withheld from evils by immediate revelations.
They shall see the Son of Man coming... = that the Word will then be revealed as to its internal sense, in which is the Lord.
That (interior natural truths) cannot be revealed. Signified.
Divine revelation, or the Word. Treated of.
If interior truths had been revealed, they would have profaned them. Signified.
That (His Human is Divine) could not be openly revealed, because...
Joseph came... in the morning = what is revealed and clear to the Celestial of the Spiritual. Explained.
Perception is an internal revelation. Hence the morning = what is revealed.
Revelation from perception. Signified... For revelation is internal perception, and is from perception.
Revelation from perception from the Celestial in the Natural, what it had in itself. Signified, Explained. AC 5150.
All revelation is either from speech with the Angels through whom the Lord is speaking, or from perception.

Those who are in good and thence in truth, especially those who are in the good of love to the Lord, have revelation from perception; whereas those who are not in good and thence in truth, may indeed have revelations, but not from perception, but by a living voice heard in them, thus through Angels from the Lord: this revelation is external, but the former internal. The Angels, especially the celestial, have revelation from perception, as had the men of the Most Ancient Church, and some of the Ancient Church, but scarcely anyone at this day; whereas very many, even of those who have not been in good, have had revelations from speech without perception, and also by visions, or by dreams. Such were most of the revelations of the prophets in the Jewish Church: they heard a voice, saw a vision, dreamed a dream; but, as they had no perception, they were merely verbal or visual revelations, without perception of what they signified...
But the revelation from perception, which the Lord had... was from the Divine in Himself...
Hence Divine revelation is called the Word.
Zaphnath Paaneah means the revealer of hidden things... which, in the celestial sense, = the Divine in it; for to reveal hidden things... is of the Lord alone.

God said to Israel in the visions of the night = obscure revelation... For revelations were made either by dreams, or by visions of the night, or by visions of the day, or by speech within the man, or by speech outside of him by visible Angels, and also by Angels not visible. By these things, in the Word, are signified various species of revelations; by a vision of the night, obscure revelation. Explained.
(This) is an arcanum which no one can know except from revelation. AC 8794:2.
This (concerning influx) it has been given to know by revelation.
Therefore the internal things of the Church were not revealed to them.
I will see this great vision = reflection upon this revelation.

That this is so, no one can know except from revelation; for man has no Knowledge of the things which come forth in the other life, except from revelation; and as man is but little solicitous to explore the truths and goods of faith from the Word... such things are not revealed to him. AC 7519:2.
A truth of order then revealed. Signified.
That in the end of the former state [there shall be] a revelation that they are delivered. Signified, Explained.
That which Jehovah gives to Know is called a revelation.
The Lord has revealed (to the inhabitants of Jupiter) how they should live and believe; and what He has revealed is handed down...
These things man must learn from revelation. (AC 8637, enumerated.)
That things are then disposed from revealed truth. Signified, Explained.

By revelation is meant illustration when the Word is being read, and perception then; for those who are in good, and long for truth, are thus taught from the Word; but those who are not in good cannot be taught from the Word... The reason those in good have revelation, and those in evil have not revelation, is that each and all things in the Word, in the internal sense, treat of the Lord and His Kingdom; and the Angels who are with the man perceive the Word according to the internal sense: this is communicated to the man who is in good, and reads the Word, and longs for truth from affection...

But the quality of the revelation possessed by those who are in good, and thence in the affection of truth, cannot be described: it is not manifest, neither is it completely hidden; but it is a certain consent and approval from within that the thing is true, or disapproval if it is not true. When there is approval, the mind is restful and serene, and in that state there is the acknowledgement which is of faith...
It treats (in  et seq.) of the revelation of truth Divine by the Lord out of Heaven; and, in this chapter, of the preparation to receive it.
Influx of the Divine through truth from the Divine concerning the revelation. Signified, Explained.

By revelation, here, in the internal sense, is not meant a revelation such as was made to the Israelitish people from Sinai, in that the Lord spoke with a sonorous voice... but there is meant the revelation which is not made with a sonorous voice, but within the man: this revelation is made by an illustration of the internal sight, which is the understanding, when a man who is in the affection of truth from good, is reading the Word, This illustration is then made by the light of Heaven... By this light the understanding is illustrated (or enlightened) no otherwise than is the external sight... by the light from the sun of the world. When the understanding is enlightened by this Divine light, he then perceives that to be true which is true; he acknowledges it within himself, and as it were sees it. Such is the revelation possessed by those who are in the affection of truth from good, when they are reading the Word. Further explained.
(Hence it is) evident how the case is with the revelation of truth from the Word.
Revelation concerning the preparation. Signified.
To say, when by Jehovah, = revelation by the Divine.
A Divine state in which there was revelation. Signified, Explained.
What is general of the revelation... manifested by the medium of Heaven. Signified, Explained.
For truth Divine is revelation.

It is believed that man can know many things of religion from natural lumen, thus without revelation... but I have been instructed by much experience, that without revelation man knows nothing whatever from himself about Divine things, and about the things which belong to heavenly and spiritual life. Explained.
The ancients who were Gentiles (knew that there is a Divine, that man is immortal, etc.) from revelation, which had emanated to them from the Church...

The gentiles of this day who also know (these things) have them from a religiosity which they have derived from ancient times... and which in various ways had emanated from the Church where there was a revelation.
The Knowledges of spiritual things must be from revelation.
For without the Word, that is, without revealed Divine truth, there is no conjunction (with Heaven); and... the human race perishes.
The Lord always provides that there shall be a Church... in which there is revealed truth Divine, which, in our Earth, is the Word.
A vision of vanity = a false revelation.
To see, or a vision, when said of the prophets, = a revelation which regards doctrine; and to divine, and a divination, = a revelation which regards life.
A light for the revelation of the gentiles ().
That justice is the good of charity from the Lord, is meant by, My justice is near that it be revealed ().
That the Divine truth could not be revealed to men, except by Jehovah in a human form. Illustrated.
All these things, without a revelation would have been utterly unknown.

In every other Earth truth Divine is manifested orally through Spirits and Angels... but this is done within the families; and therefore the Divine truth which has been revealed in this way... is not carried far beyond the families; and unless a new revelation constantly succeeds, it is either perverted, or perishes.
The promulgation of the Law... signified the revelation of Divine truth in general; for this was the beginning of the revelation...
Shall He find faith on the earth? = when truth Divine shall be revealed out of Heaven, it will not be believed... The coming of the Lord = the revelation of truth Divine at the end of the Church.
So shall the coming of the Son of Man be = the revelation of truth Divine in the consummation of the age...

The breastplate... through the shining forth of the light of Heaven, revealed Divine truths in the natural sphere, thus in ultimates. A like shining forth is presented inwardly with those who are in truths from good, which dictates, and as it were gives answers, when truth is inquired after from the affection of the heart, and is loved as good. That there is such a shining forth, by which Divine truth from Heaven is revealed in the natural man, with those who are enlightened from the Word, is not perceived in the world...
Uncover thine hair... uncover the leg: thy nakedness, shall be uncovered ()... To uncover the hair, etc. = to prostitute external and internal holy things without shame...
Without revelation from the Divine, man cannot know anything about eternal life, nor about God, and still less about love and faith in Him. Explained.
Although they know from revelation that there is a God, etc...
It follows that from love towards the human race, the Divine must reveal such things as lead to (eternal) life...
That which the Divine reveals is, with us, the Word.
The Word, being a revelation from the Divine, is Divine in each and all things.
How revelations have succeeded one another from the most ancient ages to the present. Explained.

At this day revelation is given solely through the Word; but genuine revelation, with those who are in the love of truth for the sake of truth; and not with those who are in the love of truth for the sake of honours and gain. Explained.
Revelation, in our Earth, I said, is effected by writing and preaching from the Word, and not by immediate intercourse, as in other Earths...
That Divine truth and good will be revealed to those who receive. Signified, Explained.
A new arising of the revelation of Divine truth (from the Inmost Heaven...) See AC 10606. Signified, Explained.
For Mount Sinai = Heaven whence is revelation.
Thence descends the Word, which is Divine revelation.

In the Most Ancient times there was no Word, but immediate revelation before the man of the Church, and, through it, conjunction; for, when there is immediate revelation there is the conjunction of Heaven with man.
When this immediate revelation ceased... another revelation succeeded, which was by means of representatives...
(Revelation in the Sixth Earth.) Explained.
The coming of the Lord in the clouds with power and glory = His presence in the Word, and revelation. DSS 14:2.
That in the end of the Church... the Lord... would reveal the arcana of Heaven. Signified. The arcana which are revealed in what follows are about Heaven, etc.
The reason such an immediate revelation comes forth at this day, is that this is what is meant by the advent of the Lord.
12. A trumpet = Divine truth... revealed from Heaven. References.
The Most Ancients had immediate revelation, because their interiors were turned towards Heaven... After those times, there was not such immediate revelation, but mediate through correspondences...

Such a Word (as we have, is necessary on this Earth) because the man of this Earth is such that he cannot receive immediate revelation, and by it be instructed about truths Divine, as can the inhabitants of other Earths; for the former are more in... external things, and it is internal ones which receive revelation; if external things were to receive it, the truth would not be understood.
According to the descriptions in the Book of Revelation.
At this day interior Divine truths are being revealed with that (gentile) nation.

Therefore if anything had been revealed by the Lord (before the Last Judgment) it would either not have been understood, or if understood would not have been received, or if received would have afterwards been suffocated.
That hence it is, that after the Last Judgment, and not before, revelations have been made for the New Church. Explained.
As the Africans are such even in the world, revelation is being made with them at this day, which goes from the middle around, but not as far as the seas... TCR 840.
(References to passages on the subject of a revelation.)
Every man is taught about Divine precepts by others who know them from religion, and not by means of immediate revelations. References.

There is also another illustration by which there is revealed to man in what faith, and in what intelligence and wisdom he is, which revelation is such that he perceives it in himself. He is let into a Society where there is genuine faith, etc...
(Title). The Apocalypse Revealed.
Preface. That this Revelation is from the Lord alone, and that it is received by those who will be in His New Church... Treated of.

The Revelation of Jesus Christ () = predictions from the Lord concerning Himself and His Church, such as it will be at its end, and such as it will be afterwards, both in the Heavens and on earth. The Revelation of Jesus Christ = all predictions; and, as they are by the Lord, it is said the Revelation of Jesus Christ. AE 5.
The things which have been revealed by the Lord through Heaven to those in the good of life... Signified, Explained. AE 8.
These see in John's visions the arcana... (only) when they see them revealed.
That the Lord will reveal Himself in the sense of the letter... Signified, Explained. AE 36.
That He will reveal the spiritual sense. Signified.
Manifest perception of Divine truth revealed from Heaven. Signified, Explained. AE 55.
Revelations about future things before the Last Judgment, concerning it, and after it. Signified. AE 261.
A revelation by the Lord concerning His New Church... and concerning the difficult reception of and assault on its doctrine. Signified, Explained.
A revelation by the Lord concerning the state of the Church on earth... Signified, Explained.
A revelation by the Lord from the Inmost Heaven concerning the Roman Catholic religiosity. Signified, Explained.
The spiritual sense of the Word revealed by the Lord. Signified, Explained.
That the quality of the Word in its spiritual and celestial sense no one sees but the Lord, and he to whom He reveals it. Signified, Explained.
That the Lord... has revealed through Heaven to those who are in truths from Him the things which will certainly be. Signified, Explained.
Those arcana at this day revealed by the Lord... are reputed as of no value.

Knowledge about God, and thence the acknowledgement of God, are not possible without revelation; and Knowledge about the Lord... is not possible except from the Word, which is the crown of revelations; for man, by the revelation which is given, is able to approach God...

The primeval revelation pervaded the universal world, and the natural man perverted it in many ways... Hence those who have Known from the Word, or some other revelation, that there is a God, differ...
It is from this revelation that the natural man can elevate himself above nature...
Revelations at this day.
Said that so many revelations would confuse the mind...
The uses of all things reveal the Creator. Explained.
A revelation necessary...
On [my] revelations. - They are in place of miracles; and without them people would not know there was such a book...
He supposed this was a revelation beyond any other.
Unless men had previously known these things from revelation...
They who have faith from revelation, can be confirmed from nature, miracles, etc... But those who have not faith from revelation cannot...
A revelation from Heaven being made with the gentiles. Explained. SE 4774, Described. SE 4775. LJPost 116.
The Church is being instaurated in Africa by the Lord alone by means of revelations, and not through missionaries.
They answered that they look upwards to the stars, and have a revelation thence.
Those inflow into the Hells, and reveal to them what they see below.
Hence immediate revelations are not given.
The Africans with whom is the revelation do not know that the Lord was born a Man...
The Apocalypse... cannot be understood... unless there is a revelation from Heaven...
To send = to reveal, because everything sent from Heaven is a revelation...
For a revelation from Heaven can be given only to those who are in the good of charity...

The coming of the Lord = the revelation of Him, and of the Divine truth which is from Him, in the Word, through the internal sense. The Lord does not reveal Himself elsewhere than in the Word, nor there otherwise than through the internal sense. AE 36:2.
I was in the isle called Patmos = a revelation to the gentiles. Explained.
I was in the spirit = a spiritual state when there is revelation.
Hence the revelation was made to John on the Lord's day. Revelation, there, is instruction about the state of the Church.
The mystery of the seven stars... = a revelation concerning...
To reveal filthy loves. Signified.
To uncover nakedness. Explained. AE 240:6. AE 240:10.
a. A door opened in heaven = arcana of Heaven revealed.
Could not be revealed before the Last Judgment, and not except through some one in the world...
The first voice = revelation now about future things...
I was in the spirit = a spiritual state with revelation.
I heard a voice... = revelation by the Lord from the Spiritual Heaven.
Unless He revealeth His secret () = to illustrate, and to open the interiors of the Word.
When the trumpet shall sound = the last state of the Church, and a revelation of Divine truth then.
Together with the advent of the Lord there is also a revelation of Divine truth.

When the end of the Church is at hand, the interiors of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, are revealed and taught, in order that the good may be separated from the evil... and besides the interiors of the Word which are revealed at the end of the Church are of service to the new Church...

So at this day, for it has now pleased the Lord to reveal many arcana of Heaven, especially the internal sense... which revelation is meant by the coming of the Lord in . The cause of the revelation at the end of the Church, is that by it may be effected a separation of the good from the evil, and also the instauration of a New Church, and this not only in the natural... but also in the Spiritual World... for the Church is in both worlds, and in each one a revelation is being made, and, through it, a separation, and also the instauration of a New Church. AE 670:4.
Such things do not fall into anyone's understanding except by living revelation and thence Knowledge of...
As these things have been revealed to me...
A great sign = a Divine revelation, etc.
The foundations of the world were laid bare () = were overturned from the bottom.
A sign = a revelation. Explained.
Thy judgments are made manifest = that Divine truths have been revealed to them. Explained.
The temple of the tabernacle of the testimony opened in heaven = the interior Divine truth in the Word revealed by the Lord.
That, before the Church has been fully devastated, the interior Word is revealed. Explained.
The quality of the Divine Providence in revealing Divine truths. Explained.

Inmost Divine truths were revealed to those of the Most Ancient Church; more exterior ones were revealed to those of the Ancient Church; and most external ones to the Hebrew... and Israelitish Church... After its end, more interior Divine truths were revealed for the Christian Church; and now still more interior truths for the coming Church...
Hence it is that now for the first time the spiritual sense of the Word is revealed.
For no one has religion except from revelation; and revelation, with us, is the Word.

To this is to be added, that immediate revelation is not given, except that which has been given in the Word... This revelation is such that everyone can be taught according to the affections of his love, and the derivative thoughts of his understanding; very little those who are not in good as to life; but much those who are; the latter are taught by means of illustration from the Lord. Explained.
To uncover the leg passing through the rivers () = to adulterate goods by reasonings.

A revelation has been made by the Lord concerning Heaven and Hell, the Last Judgment, the spiritual sense... Thus has been revealed the way to salvation, and concerning the state of man after death, and this has been done fully and plainly, so that everyone who is acquainted with the Latin language may know... more than a year ago. But the Church does not care for it... Ath 2.
At this day, the Church is being instituted with many in Africa, and revelations are being made, and they are receptible of the heavenly doctrine...

At this day some are speaking with the Africans in the world, instructing them orally. The speech with them falls especially into their interior perception, and they perceive the influx, and thus receive revelations with illustration; and such speech is made to the instructors, in whom they have faith.
God cannot be manifested to (these Gentiles), because they are not willing to believe that He has been born a Man... and this is the primary thing of all revelation.

The Most Ancients on this Earth had immediate revelation, and therefore they had not a written Word; but after those times, when immediate revelation could not be given without danger to their souls, nor be received... it pleased the Lord to reveal Divine truth by means of a Word which has been written by mere correspondences...
How greatly the mediate revelation which is made through the Word excels the immediate revelation which is made through Spirits. Explained.
There exists no natural theology without revelation.
De Miraculis. 5. These revelations (by means of Swedenborg) are not miracles...
That the Lord... from this New Heaven produces a New Church on earth, which is done by means of a revelation of Truths from His own mouth, or from His Word, and inspiration. Explained.
That the third of Redemption was a revelation of Truths from the New Heaven, and the consequent raising up of a New Church...
Religion is not possible except by means of some revelation, and by means of the propagation of this revelation from nation to nation.

This (disclosing of the spiritual sense) excels all the revelations which have been made since the creation... Through this revelation there is an open communication of men with the Angels of Heaven, and there has been effected a conjunction of both worlds...
